data.name: Nautitech 40 "Erasmus" - Coronado Captain Charter
data.headline: 3 - 6 hours
data.description: The ultimate small group sailing experience!
data.what_is_included: The Open 40 has been designed for lovers of sailing and good life. This luxury catamaran combines sailing sensations and absolute comfort on board, so that you never have to choose between the two. Whether you are an experienced skipper or a beginner cruiser, the Open 40 will take you and your family on a journey of discovery at sea. Beautiful moments of sharing on the horizon.
data.what_to_bring: Photo ID and credit card used for payment required for check in. Captain's fee is $75/hour + gratuity, paid directly to captain in cash
data.cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
data.cancellation_notes: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund. Once you are within 72 hours, no changes or cancellations are permitted. Failure to show for reservation still incurs full rental rate and is not eligible for a refund or reschedule. As the renter, you are responsible for checking the weather forecast and making any desired changes at least 72 hours in advance.
data.booking_notes:
##What to bring
Photo ID and credit card used for payment required for check in. 

**If you are hiring a captain**  -- captains who are available for hire charge $75/hour, plus gratuity, paid in cash directly to your captain.
data.disclaimers: Equivalent sailing experience required. A sailing resume will need to be completed at least 48 hours prior to rental for new customers.
